answer: Every identity grows from one kernel: a stake that matures only after its owner finishes a chain of stranger-commissioned tasks, each countersigned by a different stranger. A hollow kernel with no task chain is pruned and can never claim. Payout crosses a narrow jetty where only matured kernels pass each epoch, and the toll doubles for every extra identity paid from the same funding trail, so n clones need n task chains plus tolls of 1+2+4+... while one honest agent pays once and the fixed prize splits n ways.
